journals.title: Panorama Frontier Review
journals.description: Panorama Frontier Review (PFR) publishes original research and analytical scholarship on emerging issues, interdisciplinary debates, and frontier developments across the humanities and social sciences.

journals.title: AI & Future Society
journals.description: AI & Future Society (AFS) advances scholarship on AI ethics, governance, regulation, human-AI interaction, and the societal transformations driven by intelligent technologies.

journals.title: Journal of Engineering Systems & Applications
journals.description: Journal of Engineering Systems and Applications (JESA) publishes peer-reviewed interdisciplinary research in engineering systems, applied sciences, and technology-driven solutions for industry and society.

journals.title: Health Nexus: Digital Health and Medical AI
journals.description: Health Nexus: Digital Health and Medical AI (HNDH) is an international peer-reviewed, open-access journal for rigorous research in digital health, medical artificial intelligence, clinical informatics, health data science and technology-enabled healthcare innovation.

journals.title: Climate Sustainability & Global Systems
journals.description: Publishes interdisciplinary research on climate science, sustainability transitions, environmental data innovation, systemic risk, and global systems governance.

journals.title: Rural Governance & Green Development
journals.description: Publishes interdisciplinary research across rural governance, green development, sustainable agriculture, ecological governance, and rural transformation.

journals.title: Health Nexus
journals.description: Health Nexus: Interdisciplinary Medical Research Journal advances scholarship in interdisciplinary medicine, public health, and translational health sciences through rigorous double-blind peer review and open-access dissemination.

journals.title: Food Systems, Safety & Sustainability
journals.description: Food Systems, Safety & Sustainability (FSSS) is an international peer-reviewed journal for research connecting food safety, resilient supply chains, nutrition, sustainability, policy, innovation and the social conditions of food systems.

journals.title: Journal of Sport and Exercise Studies
journals.description: Journal of Sport and Exercise Studies (SES) is an international peer-reviewed journal dedicated to sport science, exercise studies, physical activity, health, coaching, performance, and related interdisciplinary inquiry.

journals.title: Global Public Policy & Governance Review
journals.description: Global Public Policy & Governance Review (GPPGR) is an international peer-reviewed journal dedicated to public policy analysis, governance, public administration, and comparative institutional research.

journals.title: PoliEcoM Administration Review
journals.description: Publishes original research and critical reviews on political economy, governance, public administration, policy implementation, and management in global and regional contexts.

journals.title: Computational Social Sciences Review
journals.description: Computational Social Sciences Review (CSSR) is an international peer-reviewed journal advancing computational and data-driven approaches to human behavior, social systems, politics, culture, and economic dynamics.

journals.title: Journal of Law, Psychology, & Communication
journals.description: Publishes original, methodologically rigorous, and socially relevant research at the intersections of law, psychology, communication, digital governance, and institutional practice.

journals.title: International Review of Education & Learning
journals.description: Publishes interdisciplinary research that advances educational theory, learning sciences, teaching practice, digital education, educational psychology, and education policy across diverse global contexts.

journals.title: Journal of Social Cognition and Communication
journals.description: An international, peer-reviewed, open-access journal dedicated to advancing research at the intersection of social cognition, communication, media, and contemporary society.

journals.title: Contemporary Review of Political Thought
journals.description: Publishes original research and critical reviews on contemporary political thought, political philosophy, intellectual history, Marxist theory, higher education governance, and public reason.

journals.title: Silence
journals.description: Silence is an international peer-reviewed journal dedicated to mature, reflective, and analytically rigorous scholarship across interdisciplinary silence studies and social inquiry.

journals.title: Global Review of Humanities, Arts, & Society
journals.description: Publishes interdisciplinary research across the humanities, arts, culture, and society, with attention to cross-cultural interpretation and public life.

journals.title: Three Teachings Studies
journals.description: Three Teachings Studies (TTS) is a peer-reviewed open-access journal devoted to critical and interdisciplinary research on Confucianism, Daoism, and Buddhism.

journals.title: Resonance
journals.description: Resonance: Journal of Global Music Studies is an international peer-reviewed journal exploring musicology, ethnomusicology, sound cultures, and cross-cultural sonic inquiry.

journals.title: Comparative Philosophy & Religious Traditions
journals.description: Comparative Philosophy and Religious Traditions (CPRT) is an international peer-reviewed open access journal for rigorous scholarship at the intersection of comparative philosophy, theology, religious traditions, and intellectual history.

journals.title: Journal of Dance and Embodied Structure
journals.description: Journal of Dance and Embodied Structure (JDES) is an international peer-reviewed journal dedicated to dance studies, embodied research, choreography, movement analysis, performance studies, and related interdisciplinary inquiry.
